Keep the main action in the vertical center with about 12% clear space at top and bottom; no on-screen text, logos or watermarks. A warm brass floor lamp lights the room; through the floor-to-ceiling window the night sky is dry and starry and the towers are sharp. Deep focus, crisp detail.
[Shot 1] Wide shot of the empty apartment, eye level, static. The front door at frame left swings shut with a solid click. The empty room stays still: the long oak table, the brass floor lamp still glowing warm, and beyond the floor-to-ceiling window the dry starry sky over crisp city towers. No one is in the room. The shot ends on the still, empty room.

overall_soundscape:
The door latch clicking shut, footsteps fading in the hallway outside, quiet room tone, a distant siren far below.
